description: On-chain agent credential registry on Solana devnet (Anchor 1.1). An issuer writes a credential PDA (seeds ["credential", agent, credential_type]), can fetch it while valid, and can revoke it. The IDL was hand-derived from source and confirmed by live devnet transactions.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/agenttrust-sol fork. The lab only changed declare_id / Anchor.toml to the Sol.College devnet program. The IDL on the hosted console was hand-derived from source because anchor idl build failed in this toolchain; instruction discriminators were confirmed by the verifying transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (issue_credential, get_credential, revoke_credential)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agenttrust/
QA: devnet proof of issue_credential campus-scout, get_credential, revoke_credential, AlreadyRevoked, and a 33-byte type rejected as a PDA seed
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise UnauthorizedRevoke with a second wallet against a lab-issued credential
